issues.description: Page is stuck in loading state — the AI-redesigned room image and before/after slider are never shown. The loading steps never progress to completion and the result UI never renders.
issues.root_cause: The page likely simulates a loading sequence with setTimeout/setInterval steps but either the state machine never transitions to 'complete', or the condition to show the result (image + slider) is gated on data that never arrives (e.g. a missing sessionStorage key, failed API call, or the progress steps complete but isLoading stays true). The hydration errors ('Text content does not match server-rendered HTML') also suggest the loading step text or timer is being rendered on the server with a different value than on the client, causing a full client re-render that may reset state and stall the progress.

issues.description: Multiple React hydration errors: 'Text content does not match server-rendered HTML' (7 instances) causing the entire root to switch to client rendering. This likely resets the component's loading progress state on mount.
issues.root_cause: The step-8a page.tsx likely uses Date.now(), Math.random(), or a non-deterministic value in the initial render, OR renders client-only state (e.g. a step index or timer-driven label) without suppressing SSR or wrapping in useEffect/dynamic import with ssr:false. The server renders one text value and the client renders another, causing hydration failure and a full re-render that resets the loading animation.

issues.description: No before/after image slider is visible — the primary deliverable of this screen is completely absent.
issues.root_cause: The result section containing the slider is conditionally rendered only when loading is complete (e.g. `if (!isLoading) return <ResultScreen />`), but since loading never completes, the slider is never mounted.

fixes.reason: Ensures client-only state is only used after mount, preventing SSR/client mismatch hydration errors that reset state.
Prevents server-rendering the dynamic loading UI entirely, eliminating the hydration mismatch and allowing the client to render fresh, avoiding state resets.

Ensures the loading steps actually advance through all 4 stages and then set isLoading=false so the result/slider screen renders. If this useEffect already exists, it may be conflicting — this provides a clean guaranteed progression.
